Dubwool

Normal

Galar · Generation 8

Dubwool is a Normal-type Sheep Pokémon first found in Galar (Generation 8). It stands 1.3 m tall and weighs 43 kg. It evolves from Wooloo. Its highest base stat is Defense (100), with a base stat total of 490.
